description: Kan-Agent atomic tool contract (7 tools). Machine-readable single source of truth for Agent Runtime tool registration (customized Pi) and fine-tuning trajectory construction. Human-readable design: docs/HIGH_LEVEL_DESIGN.md / docs/HIGH_LEVEL_DESIGN.zh-CN.md, section 4.5.
principles: Safety is enforced at the tool boundary, not by model self-discipline.
Enums are closed sets; values outside the enum are rejected at the tool boundary.
Tool outputs are budgeted: structured trimmed results (error tail + surrounding lines) are returned; full logs are persisted and retrievable via sys_inspect.
Tool-failure retries are capped (default 3) before escalating to the user.

function.name: repo_fetch
function.description: Fetch upstream source or an official release package from a git repo / tarball URL into an isolated workspace. For source_type=binary the URL must match the official component catalog allowlist (official distribution URLs only, no third-party mirrors).

source_type.description: Install class: official binary release vs source build.

component.description: Component name in the official component catalog. Preferred over url: resolves URL and default version automatically.

url.description: Git repo or tarball URL. Used when component is absent or as an explicit override; for source_type=binary it is validated against the official-source allowlist.

ref.description: Git tag/branch/commit for source class, or release version for binary class. Defaults to the catalog default when omitted.

function.name: install_audit
function.description: Pre-execution security audit. For source: static behavior audit of source and build scripts (configure, Makefile, CMakeLists.txt, install scripts). For binary: official-origin allowlist and integrity verification. Read-only. High-risk findings block the pipeline and require user authorization.

function.name: source_patch
function.description: Apply patches or edit build/source files in the workspace: fix compile errors or remove hazards. Writes are restricted to the workspace.

file_path.description: Target file path relative to the workspace.

action.description: Edit operation to perform on the target file.

diff.description: Unified diff content. Required when action=apply_diff.

content.description: Full new file content. Required when action=replace_content or create_file.

function.name: sandbox_build
function.description: Configure and compile source in an unprivileged isolated sandbox (namespace/chroot; no network; writable only workspace and DESTDIR). On failure, returns a budgeted log tail (error lines + surrounding context); the full log is persisted and retrievable via sys_inspect. Dependency ordering comes from catalog dependency declarations (topological sort); missing-dependency errors may trigger bounded recursive resolution (depth <= 2, catalog-only, fully audited).

build_system.description: Build system detected or chosen for this component.

configure_args.description: Extra configure/cmake arguments (optional). Install prefix is forced into the sandbox/versioned dir.

function.name: atomic_deploy
function.description: Atomically deploy build artifacts to the system store / install roots, flip symlinks, place declarative config (ld.so.conf.d, profile.d, systemd units per deploy profile) and create a new generation snapshot. Dangerous: requires confirmation.

component.description: Component name (must exist in the official component catalog).

artifact.description: Path to build output (DESTDIR) or the fetched release package.

verify_cmd.description: Post-deploy health-check command (optional). Executed in a constrained environment: allowlisted binaries, no shell metacharacters. Failure triggers system_rollback.

function.name: system_rollback
function.description: Atomically roll back component state to a historical generation: flip symlinks, restore the declarative config snapshot, run post-rollback hooks (ldconfig, systemd reload). Dangerous: requires confirmation. User data/documents are never touched.

component.description: Component name. Optional: defaults to the component of the last failed deploy.

generation.description: Target generation id to roll back to.

function.name: sys_inspect
function.description: Read-only inspection of system environment, shared-library deps, toolchain, kernel logs, persisted build/audit logs, the official component catalog, and generation history.

target.description: Path, component name, or log id depending on action (optional).
